verdict.rationale: Fidelity Private Shares is a SaaS equity-management platform, so versioned APIs with a deprecation policy are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence documents only UI workflows and a Gusto integration. It shows no public API, no versioning scheme and no deprecation policy, and probes for OpenAPI specs all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
